verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: fal mool mool fal mool fal fal mool aadh paramaadh ar a(n)t kai ana(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: From fruit one begets a seed and seed develops into a tree to give fruit, and this process continues. This system of growth has been in vogue before the beginning. Its end is beyond the end.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਸੁਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਪਿਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜ ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pit sut sut pit sut pit pit sut utapat gat at gooR mool ma(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: Father begets a son and the son then becomes a father and begets son. Thus continues the system of father-son-father. This convention of creation has very deep quintessence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਿਕ ਬਸੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਬੈਠ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਿਧੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pathik baseraa ko niberaa jiau nikas baiTh it ut vaar paar saritaa sidha(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: As the end of journey of a traveller depends upon his embarking a boat and then de-embarking from it, crossing the river defines its near and far ends, and these ends keep changing depending upon which direction a traveller is crossing the river from.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੬॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gur gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gur abigat gat simarat sikh sa(n)t hai ||56||

en.bdb: Similarly all powerful, all knowing Guru is God Himself. He is both Guru and God. This incomprehensible state can best be understood by a Guru-conscious person. (56)
